stats.notes: No Common Data Set found: SLU's Office of Institutional Research site lists a Common Data Set only for 2021-2022, so items found only in a CDS (residency and international splits, wait-list, early decision counts, GPA, admission factors, SAT total) are not added. Figures are IPEDS fall 2024 entering-class counts via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal (15,533 applied, 11,656 admitted, 1,615 enrolled), matching College Navigator's 75% admitted / 14% yield. SAT/ACT percentiles and submit rates (10% SAT, 36% ACT) are College Navigator's fall 2024 enrolled first-time students. Undergraduate enrollment (10,413) and the nonresident count (370, the nonresident-alien row) are IPEDS fall 2024 (EF2024) totals; the student-to-faculty ratio of 9 to 1 is College Navigator's. SLU is test-optional.
